tasks.build: cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build && cd .. && deno compile --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --include backend/db/migrations --include frontend/dist --output potoo backend/main.ts
tasks.fix: deno fmt && deno lint --fix && cd frontend && pnpm fix
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check backend/main.ts && cd frontend && pnpm check
